sections.name: Lantern Mine
sections.about: Wave 1 refresh (owner 2026-10-20): the starter mine in Rabbit Lands kit art - a headframe over the shaft out with daylight down it, rails down the main drift, ore carts, sledges, crates and tool racks, warm lanterns, veined crags along the walls. Layout, nodes and its peace kept. Rooms in order: shaft foot, main drift, west cut, east cut, south cut.

sections.name: Pinebrow Deep Workings
sections.danger: Kobolds and spiders in the lower cuts
sections.about: Wave 1 refresh (owner 2026-10-20): the mine kit with a darker, deeper feel - collapsed rockfall, ore carts left in the drifts, vein scree, copper-veined crags along the walls. Layout, nodes and encounters kept. Rooms in order: shaft foot, main drift, west cut, east cut, lower cuts.

sections.name: Cenote Deeps
sections.danger: Cave spiders and a moss golem
sections.about: Owner 2026-10-20: a jungle cenote laid out like the reference undergrounds - an entry grotto, a winding root tunnel, the great sinkhole with its pool, waterfall and daylight shaft, and three side caves (Drowned Gallery west, Glowmoss Grotto east, Root Crawl south-east). Rooms in order: grotto, cenote, gallery, glowmoss, crawl. Pass 2 wave C (owner 2026-10-21): only its ore moved into wall veins, and a flooded way in the Root Crawl leads under the sea to the Undercity below Suncoil.

sections.name: Boarsend Old Barrow
sections.about: Wave 1 refresh (owner 2026-10-20): drystone and moor boulders for walls; a giant skeleton in the burial hall, grave markers, candle stakes and cold wisp lanterns. Layout, nodes and encounters kept. Rooms in order: entry, hub, west grave chamber, golem chamber, burial hall.

sections.name: The Old Warren
sections.danger: Rabbits, stoats, badgers and a giant mole in the burrows
sections.about: Wave 1 (owner 2026-10-20): the warren Rabbit Lands is named for - eleven dens on looping, root-lined burrows under Warrenmead, daylight through three burrow holes. Rooms in order: way in, great den, west den, middle den, north den, queen's hall, south den, root den, west burrow, deep den, east den.

sections.name: The Amethyst Geode
sections.danger: Crystal beetles, dire wolves and an amethyst golem
sections.about: Wave 1 (owner 2026-10-20): one vast geode under Saltsound's amethyst crater, the great amethyst cluster at its heart and four bubble chambers in violet lamp light. Rooms in order: way in, great geode, singing bubble, violet bubble, south bubble, north bubble.

sections.name: Brambleshaw Undercroft
sections.danger: Giant moles and nightweave spiders in the vaults, a zombie in the old crypt
sections.about: Wave 2 (owner 2026-10-20): the wine cellars under Brambleshaw's old chapel - a cut-stone grid of barrel vaults round two piers, a press room, and a smugglers' crawl down to a forgotten crypt. Rooms in order: chapel stair, barrel vault, west cellar, press room, east vault, smugglers' hole, old crypt.

sections.name: Smugglers' Grotto
sections.danger: Tide crabs and lobsters on the ledges, a drowned pirate over the contraband
sections.about: Wave 2 (owner 2026-10-20): a long sea cave under Greenlight's lighthouse - a ledge path along a tidal channel with moored boats, contraband stowed in a side store, and daylight through a sea arch at the far end. Rooms in order: way in, lantern ledge, boat cave, sea arch, contraband store.

sections.name: The Resin Hollow
sections.danger: Amber lantern moths and mossback badgers in the roots, ember leaf spirits by the amber pools
sections.about: Wave 2 (owner 2026-10-20): under Twinbrook's great amber oak - a star of chambers round the vast root hall at its heart, glowing amber pools, the resin cutters' taps and drying racks, and daylight down the hollow trunk. Rooms in order: root door, heart of the oak, amber grotto, sap pool, deep root, cutters' camp.

sections.name: Ravenhead Basalt Tubes
sections.danger: Ashen wolves in the tubes, cave salamanders by the vents and an obsidian bear
sections.about: Wave 2 (owner 2026-10-20): old lava tubes under Ravenhead's basalt headland - two long tubes looping between column halls round a great rock pillar, ending at vents that still glow ember-orange. The longest walk of the programme. Rooms in order: way in, column hall, twin-tube hall, ember vents.

sections.name: Saltwind Caves
sections.danger: Scorpions and frilled lizards in the halls, cobras in the salt drift, an ashen wolf at the tomb
sections.about: Wave 2 (owner 2026-10-20): wind-carved sandstone halls under Ringholm - a loop of halls round a great sandstone pier, hoodoos in the gallery, an old salt drift with its rails, and a Sunmane tomb behind a trilithon. Rooms in order: way in, wind hall, hoodoo gallery, old salt drift, Sunmane tomb.

sections.name: Rimewater Ice Caves
sections.danger: Yetis, frost golems and glacier trolls; the Rime Matriarch has left her throne for the Frozen Deep below
sections.about: Wave 3 (owner 2026-10-20): a winding crevasse under Whitepeak's glacier temple climbs to a frozen waterfall hall under a daylight shaft, branching to an icicle gallery, an abandoned frost mine and the rime throne, in cold blue light. Walkable ledges (the owner's experiment): a terrace at the foot of the frozen falls and the throne's dais, each reached by a ramp. Rooms in order: crevasse foot, frozen falls, icicle gallery, frost mine, rime throne. Pass 2 wave C (owner 2026-10-21): the frost mine's adit (room 5) runs out to a second door on Whitepeak's south face, a shortcut under the glacier; the Rime Matriarch left her throne for the bottom of the Frozen Deep, and the throne cave holds the stair down to it. Ore in wall veins.

sections.name: Serpent Catacombs
sections.danger: Skeletons, gargoyles and mummies; the sanctum stair goes down to the Undercity
sections.about: Wave 3 (owner 2026-10-20): a formal cross of cut-stone halls under Suncoil's temple precinct - a processional lined with burial niches, a transept, two ossuary wings and the sanctum of the Drowned Lich King. Rooms in order: temple stair, processional, four burial niches, transept, sanctum, west ossuary, east ossuary. Pass 2 wave C (owner 2026-10-21): the entry level of the Serpent Underways. The Drowned Lich King went down to the Sunken Sanctum; his emptied sanctum holds the stair down into the Undercity. Ore in wall veins.

sections.name: Mirror Vaults
sections.danger: Crystal automatons, rune golems and the void construct in the sealed vault
sections.about: Wave 3 (owner 2026-10-20): square vaults on a loop under Hornmere's citadel - a lens hall where the giant lens focuses a daylight beam onto a reflecting pool, a gallery of mirror obelisks, an obelisk court and the sealed vault. Rooms in order: vault door, lens hall, mirror gallery, obelisk court, sealed vault. Pass 2 wave C (owner 2026-10-21): the stair up from the Frozen Deep opens in the vault-door hall, the end of the way under the isle from Whitepeak to Hornmere. Ore in wall veins.

sections.name: The Undercity
sections.danger: Drowned pirates, tide constructs, ghouls, temple guards and mummies in the buried streets
sections.about: Pass 2 wave C (owner 2026-10-21): the middle level of the Serpent Underways, a huge looped ruin under the hidden ruined city round Suncoil's great temple - a grid of buried plazas (shrines, markets, tombs, colonnades, cisterns, fallen plazas lit through collapsed streets) joined by two avenues through the forum and narrow lanes choked with fallen masonry, round the ruined blocks. The stair down from the Serpent Catacombs arrives in the north-west plaza; the north-east quarter's chapel cellar door (north side) and the sea-cliff door (south-east corner) make a three-door shortcut across Suncoil with the Catacombs' door; the forum's stair goes down to the Sunken Sanctum; a flooded way in the south-west cistern leads under the sea to the Cenote Deeps on Coilmere. Rooms in order: an 8 x 6 lattice of plazas, west to east, then south to north.

sections.name: The Sunken Sanctum
sections.danger: Mummies, death knights and a sunken colossus; the Drowned Lich King on his throne in the apse
sections.about: Pass 2 wave C (owner 2026-10-21): the deep end of the Serpent Underways, a flooded temple hall below the Undercity's forum - a landing where the forum stair comes out of the water, a nave whose aisles are flooded either side of the causeway, drowned colonnades, two chapels, and the apse where the Drowned Lich King sits. Rooms in order: landing, vestibule, nave, apse, north chapel, south chapel.

sections.name: The Frozen Deep
sections.danger: Yetis, polar bears, frost golems, glacier trolls and paladins; the Rime Matriarch in her lair
sections.about: Pass 2 wave C (owner 2026-10-21): a vast ice cavern under the Rimewater Ice Caves - ice chambers looped round glacier islands, the frozen falls in the great hall, and the Rime Matriarch's lair at the bottom, down one winding way off the east end. The stair from the Ice Caves' throne cave comes down on the west side; a stair in the north-east chamber climbs to the Mirror Vaults under Hornmere. Rooms in order: a 6 x 4 lattice of chambers west to east, then south to north, then the lair.

the Undercity's forum down to the Sunken Sanctum
the Cenote Deeps' flooded way under the sea to the Undercity
the Ice Caves' throne cave down to the Frozen Deep
the Frozen Deep up to the Mirror Vaults
